The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity consumption and generation studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
